pages.observed: Frames 0 to 24 (0.0 to 0.8 s). Office interior with a window showing a grey city skyline over water. A monitor with an empty 'Visit note' panel and two dashed lines slides in from the right and settles near center by 0.6 s. A top-left label reads 'Illustration. No real clinic or screen'. From 0.6 s a caption reads 'In Texas, when documentation is AI-generated,'. Lower half of frame is a flat teal-grey surface.

Frames 30 to 54 (1.0 to 1.8 s). Same office framing. A dark wavy chain of small rounded marks rises from the lower-left desk area toward the monitor's left bezel. By 1.8 s one short dark mark and a thin cursor appear at the left of the note page under 'Visit note'. No exam table is visible in this framing; the chain rises from a small teal object near the desk edge. Caption unchanged.

Frames 60 to 84 (2.0 to 2.8 s). The dark mark chain enters the page's left edge and a row of rounded dark bars writes across the note page with a cursor, ending with a dot by 2.4 s. An 'AI draft' pill wipes on above it. A small card with a Texas state outline appears top right and draws. At 2.6 s caption reads 'who verifies the output?'. Through 2.8 s no check box is visible beside the draft line.

Frames 90 to 114 (3.0 to 3.8 s). An orange square outline draws beside the right end of the dark draft line and holds, empty. The tray under the monitor shows a slightly lowered lip. The Texas outline card at top right darkens a stroke on the coast side. Caption 'who verifies the output?' holds. Framing unchanged since 0.6 s.

Frames 120 to 144 (4.0 to 4.8 s). At 4.0 s the s1 frame holds. From 4.2 s a wider view: the monitor is small at top center on its arm, the desk takes the middle, and an empty dashed lane reads 'pilots'. Disclosure now reads 'Illustration. No real page or interface'. At 4.8 s a paper card slides in from the left edge. Below the desk the lower third is dark teal with the caption 'UT Physicians is working toward adopting a unified system,'.

Frames 150 to 174 (5.0 to 5.8 s). The 'UTHealth Houston post' card titled 'UT Physicians' lands on the left of the desk and holds. The 'pilots' lane stays empty; no unified-system outline or progress bar is visible yet. The county card marks a point near Houston. The lower ~40 percent of each frame is a plain dark teal desk front carrying the caption.

Frames 180 to 204 (6.0 to 6.8 s). A dashed outline labelled 'one unified system' wipes on beside the post card. A progress bar inside fills a short way and a teal 'working toward' tag travels with its head; a dashed end marker sits at the far right. The outline and its labels are small, occupying roughly a quarter of the frame width in the desk band. Lower third remains blank dark teal plus caption.

Frames 210 to 234 (7.0 to 7.8 s). The desk composition holds unchanged from 6.8 s through 7.6 s. Caption switches to 'Epic's ambient listening platform.' at 7.2 s. At 7.8 s a small tag partly reading 'Epic amb... listenin...' slides in at the right frame edge, still mostly off-frame.

Frames 240 to 264 (8.0 to 8.8 s). The 'Epic ambient listening' tag lands clipped to the outline's top by 8.2 s; the outline's inside stays empty except the bar. At 8.6 s a cut to a closer view: 'pilots' lane (still empty), the Epic tag, 'one unified system' and 'working toward' are large. The disclosure chip sits over the cropped monitor page. The caption 'It follows pilot programs involving DAX and Abridge.' covers the bottom of the outline and most of the progress bar.

Frames 270 to 294 (9.0 to 9.8 s). Close desk view holds. A 'DAX' tag swings in from the left at 9.4 s, then an 'Abridge' tag at 9.6 s; by 9.8 s both rest on the dashed 'pilots' lane above the Epic-tagged outline. The caption still covers the bottom of the outline and most of the bar. The lower ~45 percent of each frame below the desk is plain dark teal.

Frames 300 to 324 (10.0 to 10.8 s). All five frames are identical: the close desk composition with DAX and Abridge on the pilots lane, Epic tag on the outline, bar partly covered by the caption. No motion is visible in this second.

Frames 330 to 354 (11.0 to 11.8 s). The s2 close holds to 11.4 s, where the caption clears and the full short-filled bar is visible. A cut to a whole-room view shows the monitor at upper right, a small blank easel calendar at left and a row of six small dashed faceless outlines labelled 'physicians' on the desk. Figures and calendar are small, in a band across the lower middle of the frame.

Frames 360 to 384 (12.0 to 12.8 s). In the whole-room view, the faceless outlines fill one at a time from the left, rising from the feet; four fill and the right two stay dashed. A dashed arrow labelled 'eventually' draws above the dashed end. Figures are small, roughly a fifth of frame height at the desk. The calendar remains blank with no tag yet.

Frames 390 to 414 (13.0 to 13.8 s). The whole-room composition holds with four filled and two dashed outlines. From 13.4 s a small 'no date stated' tag slides in from the left and hangs under the blank calendar by 13.8 s. The tag text is very small at this whole-room scale.

Frames 420 to 444 (14.0 to 14.8 s). Whole-room hold to 14.2 s with the calendar tagged 'no date stated'. Cut at 14.4 s to a close: four large blank cream head-and-shoulders shapes under the word 'physicians', the fourth cut by the right edge; the dashed unfilled figures are not in frame. Caption 'with an Epic refresher.' At 14.8 s a pale blank tag edge slides in from the left below the shapes.

Frames 450 to 474 (15.0 to 15.8 s). A large teal 'Epic refresher' tag rests under the row of four large blank cream figures; a thin string draws from its hole up to the leftmost figure. The composition then holds; the caption clears by 15.8 s. The row's dashed right end is outside this close frame.

Frames 480 to 504 (16.0 to 16.8 s). Cut to the whole room with an empty desk for about half a second. A small 'Abridge release / Press release' card slides in from the right and settles; an orange stamp outline draws on its lower part and its words write in, but at this scale the stamp text is only a few pixels tall. Caption 'On October 8th, 2026,'.

Frames 510 to 534 (17.0 to 17.8 s). The release card holds in the whole room, then a cut to a closer view shows 'Abridge release / Press release' with an orange tilted stamp reading 'October 8th, 2026'; a row of grey word marks runs through the stamp so '8th' is partly crossed. Caption 'Abridge announced an enterprise-wide agreement,' arrives at 17.4 s, but no agreement tag is on screen through 17.8 s.

Frames 540 to 564 (18.0 to 18.8 s). A peach 'enterprise-wide agreement' tag slides in from the left and lands overlapping the release card's header, hiding 'Abridge' and the first letter of 'Press release'. A dark binder clip sits on the tag directly over the 'w' of 'enterprise-wide'. A loose dark thread hangs from the tag by 18.6 s. Caption 'Abridge announced an enterprise-wide agreement,'.

Frames 570 to 594 (19.0 to 19.8 s). The release card and agreement tag hold for 0.4 s. A card headed 'initiative' reading 'University of Texas REAL Health AI' slides in from the left and settles below the tag by 19.8 s. The thread from the tag still hangs loose. Caption 'with University of Texas REAL Health AI.'.

Frames 600 to 624 (20.0 to 20.8 s). The three paper objects hold still for about 0.8 s. At 20.8 s the loose thread under the agreement tag starts to curve right toward the initiative card, not yet reaching it.

Frames 630 to 654 (21.0 to 21.8 s). The agreement tag's thread finishes and ties to the top of the initiative card with a dot by 21.2 s; caption clears at 21.4 s. Cut to the whole room: three small paper cards each labelled 'UT health institution' with a small grey switch sit at the front of the desk; their labels are a few pixels tall. No framework frame is drawn yet. Caption 'Abridge says UT health institutions can access Abridge,'.

Frames 660 to 684 (22.0 to 22.8 s). In the whole-room view a long pale bar labelled 'framework' with 'Abridge' under it draws on left to right above three small institution cards; an 'Abridge says' tag appears at its right end. All labels are small at this scale. No access threads have appeared yet.

Frames 690 to 714 (23.0 to 23.8 s). In the whole-room view, very thin dark lines fan from the center of the framework bar down to the three small institution cards, completing by 23.8 s. The lines are about one pixel wide at this phone sample and the cards' switches stay grey.

Frames 720 to 744 (24.0 to 24.8 s). The framework and three threaded institution cards hold still in the whole-room view. Caption changes to 'preserving local decision-making.' at 24.4 s. At 24.8 s the first card's tiny switch turns orange and the second begins to tint; the switches are only a few pixels wide at phone size.

Frames 750 to 774 (25.0 to 25.8 s). All three institution switches are tinted orange in the middle position; caption clears at 25.4 s. Cut to a medium view of the note screen on its arm in front of the window; the draft line and orange box are unchanged. A small dark/white shape appears above the screen's top-left at 25.8 s. Caption 'Linked Evidence, Abridge says,'. Lower third below the desk is blank teal.

Frames 780 to 804 (26.0 to 26.8 s). A paper strip of grey word-mark rows unrolls from a wall hook to the left of the note screen, its foot labelled 'source data'. Two paper tabs, 'Linked Evidence' and italic 'Abridge says', rise from behind and clip to the screen's top edge. Monitor and strip occupy the upper-middle band; labels on the tabs are small.

Frames 810 to 834 (27.0 to 27.8 s). The screen, tabs and source strip hold. From 27.4 s a thin dark thread starts at a dot on the middle of the draft line and draws up and left; at 27.8 s it crosses over the 'AI draft' chip lettering on its way toward the page's left edge. It has not reached the strip yet. Caption 'maps documentation to source data.'.

Frames 840 to 864 (28.0 to 28.8 s). The thread reaches the source strip and one strip row lights peach at 28.4 s. At 28.8 s a cut to a closer view of the screen: the thread arcs from the draft line over the 'AI draft' chip and leaves the left frame edge; the strip with its lit row is cropped to a sliver. Caption 'Clinicians can then verify the output.' sits over the tray. No check mark yet.

Frames 870 to 894 (29.0 to 29.8 s). A dashed orange outlined check mark comes down from above the screen, crosses in front of the 'Abridge says' tab, and by 29.8 s hovers above the empty orange box without landing. The thread from the draft line still exits the left edge where only a sliver of the strip shows. Caption 'Clinicians can then verify the output.'. No person or hand appears.

Frames 900 to 924 (30.0 to 30.8 s). The close screen holds unchanged: outlined check hovering above the empty orange box, the thread from the draft line out the left edge. Caption clears at 30.8 s, revealing the open tray under the screen.

Frames 930 to 954 (31.0 to 31.8 s). After a cut, the frame shows the bottom of the note screen at the very top and an empty teal desk across the middle; the lower half is dark blank teal with the caption 'A Texas Act took effect September 1st, 2025.'. For about 0.8 s no object moves. At 31.8 s a paper card headed 'Texas Senate Bill 11...' slides in from the right, showing 'enrolled bill text', 'conditions' and a 'diagnosis' pill.

Frames 960 to 984 (32.0 to 32.8 s). The bill card settles; its printed header reads 'Texas Senate Bill 1188'. An orange crooked stamp draws on and fills with 'Effective September 1st, 2025' in small type. The card and stamp occupy the top third; the lower ~60 percent of the frame is blank dark teal with the caption 'A Texas Act took effect September 1st, 2025.'.

Frames 990 to 1014 (33.0 to 33.8 s). The bill card with its stamp holds still to 33.6 s. At 33.8 s a cut to a closer view shows 'Texas Senate Bill 1188', 'enrolled bill text', the 'Effective September 1st, 2025' stamp and the unlit 'diagnosis' pill clearly. Caption 'It covers artificial intelligence used for diagnostic purposes.'.

Frames 1020 to 1044 (34.0 to 34.8 s). In the closer bill view, the 'diagnosis' pill gradually tints light orange. Otherwise the card holds. No AI tag has appeared yet. Lower ~45 percent remains dark blank teal with caption.

Frames 1050 to 1074 (35.0 to 35.8 s). The diagnosis pill holds lit. From 35.6 s a small 'AI' tag slides in along the card from its right edge and comes to rest to the right of the diagnosis pill at 35.8 s; a thin frame stroke starts at the pill's left edge.

Frames 1080 to 1104 (36.0 to 36.8 s). A thin dark frame finishes round the lit 'diagnosis' pill and the 'AI' tag and holds. At 36.8 s a cut shows the same bill card smaller at center with a stack of record cards, each with an 'AI' badge, labelled 'records' at the left edge, partly under the bill. Caption 'Its conditions include review of all AI-created records,'.

Frames 1110 to 1134 (37.0 to 37.8 s). On the bill card the second condition line is written over left to right and reads 'review all AI-created records' by 37.6 s; the highlight colour is barely distinguishable from the paper except a pale patch past the words. The record stack with AI badges sits at left under the bill's edge. No bracket has drawn yet.

Frames 1140 to 1164 (38.0 to 38.8 s). The bill and record stack hold, then a thin orange bracket stroke leaves the bill's left edge near the review line, arcs up over the stack and comes down its left side by 38.8 s, its left part touching the frame edge. The stack is small and partly hidden under the bill.

Frames 1170 to 1194 (39.0 to 39.8 s). The orange bracket holds round the small record stack. At 39.6 s a cut to a close on the bill: the 'review all AI-created records' line now shows a clear peach band; the record stack has left the frame. Caption 'under Texas Medical Board standards.'; no standards tag visible yet.

Frames 1200 to 1224 (40.0 to 40.8 s). A 'Texas Medical Board standards' tag slides in from the right and comes to rest overlapping the highlighted condition line, covering the lower half of 'review all AI-created records' so that line becomes hard to read from 40.2 s on. Caption 'under Texas Medical Board standards.'.

Frames 1230 to 1254 (41.0 to 41.8 s). The s8 close holds, then a cut at about 41.4 s to an almost identical view of the same bill card, slightly smaller; only the disclosure text changes ('No real page or seal'). The standards tag still covers the review line. Caption 'That law is written around diagnosis.'; the diagnosis pill has no new frame yet.

Frames 1260 to 1284 (42.0 to 42.8 s). An orange outline draws tightly round the 'diagnosis' pill and the pill darkens to a stronger orange. The rest of the bill card is unchanged and the standards tag still covers the review line. Caption 'That law is written around diagnosis.'.

Frames 1290 to 1314 (43.0 to 43.8 s). The framed-diagnosis close holds to 43.4 s, then a cut to a wider view in which the bill card is small at upper center with empty desk to its left and blank dark teal below. Caption 'The bill doesn't say whether a visit note counts.'; no visit note card yet.

Frames 1320 to 1344 (44.0 to 44.8 s). A small 'visit note' card with an 'AI' pill slides in from the left and stops at the bill card's left edge, next to the orange-framed diagnosis pill. Both are small in the upper third of the frame; below is blank dark teal and the caption.

Frames 1350 to 1374 (45.0 to 45.8 s). The visit note card holds against the bill. From 45.6 s a small orange '?' tag rises from behind the visit note and by 45.8 s sits above it at the bill's left edge. The question tag is roughly 15 pixels wide in the 390-wide phone sample; it sits beside 'conditions' rather than visibly at the diagnosis pill.

Frames 1380 to 1404 (46.0 to 46.8 s). The question tag and visit note hold beside the bill. At 46.8 s a cut to a wider view of the note screen: tabs on top, the source strip with its lit row and thread, the outlined check above the empty box. Two new cards lie on the desk below: 'Abridge says / clinicians can verify' and 'Texas law / review for diagnostic use'. Caption 'Abridge says clinicians can verify.'.

Frames 1410 to 1434 (47.0 to 47.8 s). A teal thread draws from the 'Abridge says / clinicians can verify' card up over the tray, the screen's chin and the lower note page, ending at the left edge of the empty orange box by 47.8 s. The outlined check still hovers above the box. The thread is drawn across the front of the monitor bezel.

Frames 1440 to 1464 (48.0 to 48.8 s). The teal vendor thread ties to the left edge of the empty box. A cut at about 48.4 s shows a medium view with the screen at upper left and the 'Texas law / review for diagnostic use' card at lower left; the Abridge card leaves frame. A peach label begins to slide in from the left. In these medium frames the desk and its dark face end before the right frame edge, leaving a pale vertical strip down the right side. Caption 'The law requires review for diagnostic use.'.

Frames 1470 to 1494 (49.0 to 49.8 s). A peach label reading 'Texas law requires review for diagnostic use' rides up across the screen, briefly passes over the empty box, and settles on the note page under the draft line. A dark statute thread draws from the 'Texas law' card on the desk up across the bezel to the box's left edge beside the teal vendor knot. The check outline still hovers. A pale band remains down the right edge where the desk face ends.

Frames 1500 to 1524 (50.0 to 50.8 s). The medium view holds unchanged: both threads knotted at the empty box's left edge, the peach law label on the page, the check outline above the box, the Texas law card below. The pale strip down the right edge persists.

Frames 1530 to 1554 (51.0 to 51.8 s). A card lowers from behind the screen's chin and hangs below it reading 'how well the check works' with an empty dashed field; the dark statute thread passes in front of its left edge hiding the 'h'. At 51.8 s an orange box draws in the field and 'not st...' writes in. Caption 'No source here says how well that check works.'.

Frames 1560 to 1584 (52.0 to 52.8 s). The 'how well the check works' card hangs under the chin with an orange 'not stated' mark complete in its field. Everything holds still through 52.8 s; no source cards have appeared. The 'how well' card is small, about a fifth of the frame width, beside the large Texas law card.

Frames 1590 to 1614 (53.0 to 53.8 s). Three small source cards slide in from the left and settle fanned at the screen chin's lower left; only 'Texas bill text' is fully legible, the other two labels overlap and are partly cut. The closing composition holds: empty box with two knotted threads, hovering outlined check, law label on page, 'how well the check works / not stated' card, Texas law card.

Frames 1620 to 1644 (54.0 to 54.8 s). The closing composition holds without caption for about a quarter second, then cuts to a dark credits card: 'THE DAILY DISPATCH', Lone Star flag icon, 'Texas AI Docket', 'texasaidocket.com', sources 'UTHealth Houston school post, Abridge release, Texas enrolled bill text', and 'Original authored diagrams, no brand marks'.
Frames 1650 to 1674 (55.0 to 55.8 s). The dark credits card holds unchanged in all five frames.
Frames 1680 to 1704 (56.0 to 56.8 s). The same dark credits card holds unchanged in all five frames.
Frames 1710 to 1734 (57.0 to 57.8 s). The dark credits card holds unchanged in all five frames.
Frames 1740 to 1764 (58.0 to 58.8 s). The dark credits card holds unchanged in all five frames.
Frames 1770, 1776 and the final frame 1777 (59.0 to 59.233 s). The dark credits card holds unchanged to the last frame of film A.

Frames 0 to 24 (0.0 to 0.8 s). The same opening as film A at this sampling: office window with skyline, a monitor with an empty 'Visit note' page slides in from the right and settles by 0.6 s; a small dark mark curls up at the desk's left at 0.8 s. Caption 'In Texas, when documentation is AI-generated,'. No reticle ticks visible yet.

Frames 30 to 54 (1.0 to 1.8 s). Identical action to film A at this interval: a dark wavy chain of word marks rises from a small teal object at the desk's left toward the monitor, and at 1.8 s the first mark and cursor appear on the note page. No exam table is in frame.

Frames 60 to 84 (2.0 to 2.8 s). The draft line writes across the page and the 'AI draft' chip wipes on, as in A. At 2.8 s, unlike A, four orange corner ticks frame an empty space to the right of the draft line, with a short orange stroke starting inside them. Caption 'who verifies the output?'.

Frames 90 to 114 (3.0 to 3.8 s). A tilted orange square draws inside the four corner ticks beside the draft line and holds empty; the ticks make the box read as a targeted spot. The county card draws its outline. Composition is the same as film A otherwise.

Frames 120 to 144 (4.0 to 4.8 s). Same cut and framing as film A's scene 2 opening: monitor small at upper right, an empty dashed 'pilots' lane on the desk, blank dark teal lower 40 percent with the caption. Only difference visible is the four orange corner ticks round the box on the monitor. A card enters from the left at 4.8 s.

Frames 150 to 174 (5.0 to 5.8 s). Same as film A: the post card lands and holds; empty pilots lane; county card rings near Houston. The reticle ticks remain round the box on the small monitor. No unified-system outline yet.

Frames 180 to 204 (6.0 to 6.8 s). Identical to film A: the dashed 'one unified system' outline wipes on beside the post card, its bar fills a short way and stops with the 'working toward' tag at the head. Labels are small within the desk band.

Frames 210 to 234 (7.0 to 7.8 s). Same as film A: the desk composition holds unchanged while the caption switches to 'Epic's ambient listening platform.'; the Epic tag only begins to enter at the right edge at 7.8 s. In B the box with reticle ticks stays visible on the small monitor at upper right.

Frames 240 to 264 (8.0 to 8.8 s). The Epic tag settles on the outline. At 8.6 s a cut to a split: two stacked rounded panes on a blurred pale field, the upper showing the empty 'pilots' lane large, the lower a large 'Epic ambient listening' tag over the words 'one unified system', cut by the pane's bottom edge; the caption box sits over the pane boundary. Below the panes is a blurred pale area.

Frames 270 to 294 (9.0 to 9.8 s). In the large upper pane, a 'DAX' tag and then an 'Abridge' tag swing in and settle side by side on the 'pilots' lane by 9.8 s; the lower pane holds the large 'Epic ambient listening' tag over 'one unified system'. Text in both panes is large and legible. The lower half of the frame below the panes is a blurred pale field with the caption at the boundary.
Frames 300 to 324 (10.0 to 10.8 s). All five frames are identical: the split view with DAX and Abridge on the pilots lane above and the Epic tag below. No motion this second.

Frames 330 to 354 (11.0 to 11.8 s). The split holds to 11.4 s. A cut shows the note screen with its reticle box at upper right, a blank calendar cut by the left frame edge and six dashed faceless outlines labelled 'physicians' across the desk, larger than in film A's room view. The caption sits over the desk front.

Frames 360 to 384 (12.0 to 12.8 s). The same fill action as film A, at a larger scale: four faceless outlines fill one at a time and two stay dashed under a dashed 'eventually' arrow. The figures here are roughly twice the size of film A's room-view figures.

Frames 390 to 414 (13.0 to 13.8 s). Hold, then a 'no date stated' tag slides in under the blank calendar at the left edge; the calendar itself is half outside the frame, so the tag sits close to the edge.

Frames 420 to 444 (14.0 to 14.8 s). After a hold, a cut to a tighter view keeps the whole six-figure row, including the two dashed right-end outlines and the 'eventually' arrow, with the bottom of the note screen and its reticle box at top. The calendar leaves the frame. At 14.8 s a pale tag enters at the left below the row.

Frames 450 to 474 (15.0 to 15.8 s). An 'Epic refresher' tag settles at the front-left of the row and a thin string draws from it to the first figure. The full row with both dashed ends and the 'eventually' arrow stays visible. Holds; caption clears near 15.7 s.

Frames 480 to 504 (16.0 to 16.8 s). B cuts to a view with the note screen large at top: the reticle-framed empty box beside the AI draft line is the most prominent element. The 'Abridge release / Press release' card slides in onto the desk below and an orange 'October 8th, 2026' stamp writes onto it by 16.8 s, legible at this scale though crossed by grey marks.

Frames 510 to 534 (17.0 to 17.8 s). Same beat as film A: the release card holds, a cut to a closer view, the caption 'Abridge announced an enterprise-wide agreement,' arrives at 17.4 s while no agreement tag is yet on screen. The stamp's '8th' is crossed by a grey mark row. Lower ~45 percent blank dark teal.

Frames 540 to 564 (18.0 to 18.8 s). Identical to film A: the agreement tag lands over the release card header, its binder clip drawn on top of the 'w' in 'enterprise-wide', and a loose thread hangs from it.

Frames 570 to 594 (19.0 to 19.8 s). Same as film A: brief hold, then the 'initiative / University of Texas REAL Health AI' card slides in from the left beneath the agreement tag, whose loose thread still hangs.
Frames 600 to 624 (20.0 to 20.8 s). Same as film A: the three paper objects hold still about 0.8 s, then the loose thread begins to move toward the initiative card at 20.8 s.

Frames 630 to 654 (21.0 to 21.8 s). The thread ties to the initiative card. Cut at 21.6 s to a view with the note screen at upper right and three 'UT health institution' cards with grey switches on the desk front; their labels are small but legible. No framework drawn yet.

Frames 660 to 684 (22.0 to 22.8 s). A 'framework / Abridge' bar with an 'Abridge says' tag wipes on above the three institution cards, as in film A but at a somewhat larger scale. No access threads yet.
Frames 690 to 714 (23.0 to 23.8 s). Thin dark lines fan from the framework's center down to the three institution cards by 23.8 s; as in film A the lines are very thin at phone size.

Frames 720 to 744 (24.0 to 24.8 s). After a short hold, B cuts to a closer view of the framework's 'Abridge says' end and two large 'UT health institution' cards hanging on threads; at 24.8 s the left card's switch turns orange while resting in the middle. The switches are clearly visible at this scale, unlike film A's room view.

Frames 750 to 774 (25.0 to 25.8 s). Both large institution switches show orange in the middle position and hold. A cut to the note screen centered, the reticle-framed empty box prominent at right of the draft line; a small hook appears at the screen's left at 25.8 s. Caption 'Linked Evidence, Abridge says,'.

Frames 780 to 804 (26.0 to 26.8 s). Same action as film A at a slightly larger framing: the 'source data' strip unrolls beside the screen and the 'Linked Evidence' and 'Abridge says' tabs clip to its top edge. The reticle ticks frame the empty box.

Frames 810 to 834 (27.0 to 27.8 s). A slightly wider framing shows the screen, the source strip and the window. From 27.4 s a thin thread starts on the draft line and curls up-left over the 'AI draft' chip text toward the page edge, as in film A.

Frames 840 to 864 (28.0 to 28.8 s). The thread completes to the source strip and a matching row lights peach at 28.4 s, readable in this wider frame. At 28.8 s a cut to a close on the screen: large tabs, 'Visit note', 'AI draft' crossed by the thread, and the reticle-framed empty box large at right. The caption box sits over the screen's lower bezel.

Frames 870 to 894 (29.0 to 29.8 s). In the close, an outlined dashed orange check comes down from above, crosses in front of the 'Abridge says' tab and stops hovering above the reticle-framed empty box by 29.8 s. Larger and clearer than in film A. No person or hand appears.

Frames 900 to 924 (30.0 to 30.8 s). The close holds with the outlined check hovering above the empty, reticle-framed box. At 30.8 s the caption clears and the open tray under the screen becomes visible.

Frames 930 to 954 (31.0 to 31.8 s). B cuts to a view that keeps the whole s6 result in the upper half: thread to the lit source row, check hovering over the reticle box. The desk below stays empty for about 0.8 s, then the bill card starts sliding in from the right at 31.8 s. Caption 'A Texas Act took effect September 1st, 2025.'.

Frames 960 to 984 (32.0 to 32.8 s). The bill card headed 'Texas Senate Bill 1188' lands under the note screen and the 'Effective September 1st, 2025' stamp writes on. The caption box covers the bill's condition lines; the 'diagnosis' pill sits just below the caption. The screen with its hovering check remains in the upper half.

Frames 990 to 1014 (33.0 to 33.8 s). Hold on the bill under the screen to 33.6 s. A cut at 33.8 s to a closer view of the bill card shows all three condition lines and the unlit 'diagnosis' pill clear of the caption, which is now below the card.
Frames 1020 to 1044 (34.0 to 34.8 s). The large bill card holds; its 'diagnosis' pill tints to light orange. Same action as film A at a similar scale.

Frames 1050 to 1074 (35.0 to 35.8 s). The lit diagnosis pill holds, then an 'AI' tag slides in along the bill card from its right edge; at 35.8 s it is still travelling, about two-thirds across, with a frame stroke starting at the pill.

Frames 1080 to 1104 (36.0 to 36.8 s). A thin dark frame completes round 'diagnosis' and 'AI' and holds. At 36.8 s a cut to a view with the note screen and hovering check above, the bill card at center and a record stack with 'AI' badges labelled 'records' at the left edge, partly under the bill.
